name: What is the process for professional drain cleaning?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for professional drain cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional drain cleaning typically begins with a thorough inspection, often using a camera to pinpoint the exact location and nature of the clog. Depending on the blockage, plumbers may use a powerful auger (snake) to break up or retrieve the obstruction. For tougher clogs or accumulated grease, hydro-jetting, which uses high-pressure water, can effectively clear the pipes and remove residue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional drain cleaning involves inspection, then using tools like augers or hydro-jetting to clear the blockage. The method depends on the clog type.
